_notes: Variant: European Portuguese (pt-PT), as the existing console strings already use (ficheiro, consola, registo, propinas, 'a + infinitive'). Register: Agency = imperative, dense, implicit 'você' (o seu / abra / selecione); University = formal, impersonal, analytical; neither uses 'tu'.

Insights (both consoles) = 'Indicadores' (was 'Estatísticas' in nav and 'Análise' in v28.pipe.label); 'análise' stays reserved for the university's review of an application (Em análise, Análise da universidade). 'Revisão' is the team's document/essay review.

Intake = 'semestre de entrada' (short column header 'Entrada'); 'ingresso' replaced. Dormitory = 'residência' / 'residência universitária'. Essays = 'textos'. Mock interview = 'entrevista simulada'. Notarization = 'certificação notarial'. Standard admission letter = 'carta de admissão padrão (standard admission letter)' on first mention in a sentence; plain 'carta de admissão' in short status labels, as in English.

Hangyul HQ = 'Sede Hangyul'; Hangyul Operations = 'Operações Hangyul' (same as common:role.HANGYUL_OPERATIONS). Caseload = 'os seus casos' / 'a seu cargo'. Pipeline (agency CRM term) kept as 'pipeline' in the agency console only.
Plurals: every _one form carries {{count}} and the noun (itemsInReview_one, applicants.requested_one, submissionsNeed_one were bare numbers).

Stage chips that describe groups of students stay generic masculine plural (Admitidos, Matriculados, Chegaram, Encerrados) — standard for population labels; funnel step names that read as a single applicant were made nominal (Chegada, Matrícula confirmada). Owner decision: university:v22.manage.active/inactive ('Ativo/Inativo') agree with an unknown noun (agency vs member); left masculine.
university:v22.in.q.* Insights questions rewritten in a formal analytical voice (no 'onde os perdemos').
